I noticed the board owner specifically mentioned condemning the use of pesticides, so I thought there might be room for some discussion on the topic to share alternative eco-friendly solutions.

I'll get us started with a rough recipe for an all-natural pesticide. I don't normally feel the need to spray with anything, but once in a while some pest starts getting out of control and something needs to be done.

So, take a few big handfuls of nice hot chillis, a fistful of cloves, and a whole garlic. Throw these into a pot and fill the rest of the way with water. Boil this (WARNING: make sure you have good ventilation! beware the steam!) for at least an hour, adding more water as necessary.

Strain the liquid and put it into a spray bottle along with some vegetable oil. Shake before use (anybody know a good natural emulsifier to add to this recipe?).

This is powerful stuff that will take care of most pests, killing or at the very least driving them away. Also works great for fungal infections on plants.

Creating an environment that takes care of your pests for you is obviously the better solution, but this is a great band aid solution while you build up your garden.
